title: Backfill with a full-history second peer
severity_reason: With a full-history peer available, the backfill reaches the online-delete floor (1257) and stops there: 743 ledgers acquired. The floor, not peer availability, is the binding constraint.
notes: Same starting state as S4, with a full-history peer added. The contrast with S4 isolates the cause: the peer can supply everything, but shouldAcquire refuses below 1256 (2000-1256=744 > 256 and 1256 < minimumOnline 1257). Compare with S3, where no online-delete floor exists and the backfill stops at the 256 window instead.
